title: react-vite template UI manifest
description: Declares where UI building blocks live in scenarios generated from the react-vite template. Consumed by react-component-library's adoption resolver to compute canonical filesystem paths for adopted components.

contract.extensionRule: Scenarios may override individual slot `dir` values inside their own .vrooli/ui-manifest.json overlay. New slot names must be added to the template manifest, not the overlay.

ui-primitive.description: Headless primitives (button, input, textarea) that other components compose. Kebab-case filenames.

shared-component.description: Cross-cutting components used by multiple features or layouts (e.g. ErrorBoundary).

layout-shell.description: App shell (AppShell, root container components). Shares the layout dir with layout-nav by design.

layout-nav.description: Navigation surfaces inside the shell (Sidebar, TopBar, BottomNav). Shares the layout dir with layout-shell by design.

page.description: Routed pages mounted under the shell's Outlet.

feature.description: Feature folder. Owns its own components, hooks, API client wrapper, and tests.

feature-component.description: A single component inside a feature folder.

api-client.description: Connect-RPC client modules and small API wrappers.

i18n-strings.description: i18next catalog JSON files. One per locale.
